revision: Isolated central pillar with a machined-metal platform

critics.assessment: Pillar silhouette and lower facets are readable, and the finer steel surface is cleaner. Recognizable rings, alternating wedges, grates, substantial skirt and warm lamps match the reference. No other islands, bridges or brick tiles remain.

The center plate reads as metal, dark grating stays distinct, and amber lights retain contrast. Rock facets are readable without washing out the floor. The reference is more weathered and reflective, while this result is a coherent stylized interpretation.

refinements: Removed surrounding scene and all bridge stubs; retained only the approved rock and seven original console meshes.
Rebuilt the tiled floor as concentric metal plates and eight physical open-grating sectors.
Added four broad diagonal wedges alternating with four narrow supports; enlarged center rings, deepened the skirt, and reduced bracket density.
Darkened grates and metal plates, retained thin polished highlights, and added eight amber lamps with small warm floor pools.
Reduced cloudy shader variation and added local below-deck lighting to recover rock detail.
